items.q: So he and I became fast friends, and we used to sit down and play the piano at my house or his house.

ctx.x: make these little runs up and down the piano. So he and I became fast friends, and we used to sit down and play the piano at my house or his house.

Then along with him, a guy that at that particular time I used to play football with around a lot, whose name was George McIver. And like my mother, and so many people I've met since then that have this I don't know what you'd call it... They have this knack for knowing music, and they never play an instrument, they never studied music or anything, but there's a love that they have for it that just makes them knowledgeable about music beyond a lot of musicians that I've known who studied.
